s: According to population census 2011, in India, the number of persons with disabilities constituted:

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: How much amount is sanctioned by Government of AP as marriage incentive to a couple, in which one of the spouses is marrying a differently abled person?
x: AP gave Rs 1 lakh as a marriage incentive where one spouse marries a differently abled person (as keyed).

src: APPSC Group-II Prelims 2024 (25-02-2024)

x: The Union Cabinet approved the MoU with South Africa for cooperation in the disability sector on 15 February 2023 (an earlier MoU was with Chile, April 2022).

src: State PSC

x: The International Day of Persons with Disabilities is observed on 3 December (since 1992); 10 December is Human Rights Day and 24 October UN Day.

src: APPSC Inspector of Factories, Civil Assistant Surgeons & Fis
s: In the case of Jeeja Ghosh Vs Union of India the Supreme Court held that "people with disabilities have the right to live with dignity" and awarded compensation to her to be paid by?
x: In Jeeja Ghosh v. Union of India (12 May 2016) the Supreme Court ordered SpiceJet, which had deplaned her, to pay Rs 10 lakh compensation.

src: APPSC Assistant Social, BC & Tribal Welfare Officers Screeni

x: In Andhra Pradesh the old-age pension entry age is 60 in general but 50 for Scheduled Tribes, which covers PVTGs.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ

x: The 2007 Act obliges children and heirs to maintain parents and punishes neglect: abandoning a senior citizen carries up to 3 months jail and/or Rs 5,000 fine.

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer Screening

x: Assam's PRANAM Act (2017) made it the first State to require government employees to look after their parents, with salary deduction if they neglect them.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: According to the United Nations Children's Fund UNICEF, which country recorded the highest number of births on the first day of the new year, 2020?
x: UNICEF estimated about 67,385 babies born in India on 1 January 2020, the most of any country, ahead of China (about 46,299).

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: Which of the following pairs of states experienced the highest rate of population growth (4.97) and the lowest (0.90) respectively, during 1991-2001 A) C) in India?
x: Census 2001: Nagaland had the highest 1991-2001 growth (64.53%, annual exponential 4.97%) and Kerala the lowest (9.43%, annual 0.90%).

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s: During which period did India experience population explosion?
x: 1951-1981 is the period of population explosion in India: mortality fell fast while fertility stayed high (about 2.2% a year).

src: APPSC Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) General Studies & M

src: APPSC 2023 Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors
s: Which state has become the first in the country to provide one per cent reservation for the transgender community in all the government services in July 2021?
x: Karnataka was the first State to provide 1% horizontal reservation for transgender persons in government services (notification 6 July 2021); Kerala had the first transgender policy (2015).

src: U.P. P.C.S. (Mains) 2017
s: Who among the following is the first Indian transgender Judge?
x: Joyita Mondal of West Bengal became the first transgender judge (Lok Adalat, Islampur) on 8 July 2017.

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Geo Physics) & Technical Assistan
s: In the case of National Legal Services Authority Vs Union of India, Supreme court gave formal recognition to transgender as "third gender" and placed them in which of the following categories for the purpose of reservation in education and employment?
